search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，区域 $D:x^2+y^2\leq1$，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 可化累次积分为[\quad] $2\int_0^1dy\int_{-\sqrt{1-y^2}}^{\sqrt{1-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$ $2\int_0^1dy\int_{\sqrt{1-y^2}}^1f(x,y)dx$ $\int_{-1}^1dx\int_{-\sqrt{1-x^2}}^{\sqrt{1-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ $2\int_0^1dx\int_{-\sqrt{1-x^2}}^{\sqrt{1-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ 解答　原式 $=\int_{-1}^{1}dx\int_{-\sqrt{1-x^2}}^{\sqrt{1-x^2}}f(x,y)dy=\int_{-1}^{1}dy\int_{-\sqrt{1-y^2}}^{\sqrt{1-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$。
